What is the page-load journey, in order?¶{{c1::URL}} → {{c1::DNS}} → {{c1::TCP}} → {{c1::TLS}} → {{c1::HTTP request}} → {{c1::edge/gate/origin}} → {{c1::response}} → {{c1::render}} — repeated per asset
What is the anatomy of a URL?¶{{c1::scheme://host/path?query — protocol · machine-by-name · thing-there · options}}
What does DNS do?¶{{c1::Turns names into numeric IP addresses (the phone book) — nslookup does it by hand}}
Whose IPs answer for www.leedspunjabisociety.com?¶{{c1::Cloudflare's (104.21.x / 172.67.x) — the edge, not the Vercel origin}}
What is TCP, in one sentence?¶{{c1::A reliable, ordered, two-way pipe to a numbered port (443 for HTTPS) — a phone call, not a postcard}}
What two things does TLS give you?¶{{c1::Secrecy (encryption)}} + {{c1::identity (a certificate vouched by a trusted authority)}}
What does HSTS commit a browser to?¶{{c1::HTTPS-only for max-age seconds (2 years on your site; preload = baked into browsers)}}
What are the HTTP status families?¶2xx {{c1::worked}} · 3xx {{c1::go elsewhere}} · 4xx {{c1::you erred}} · 5xx {{c1::server erred}}
What do HTTP 307/308 promise that 301/302 don't?¶{{c1::The method won't change on the redirect — a POST stays a POST}}
What are your site's two real redirects, and why do they differ?¶vercel.app → {{c1::308 permanent (address moved for good)}}; /dashboard logged-out → {{c1::307 temporary (log in and it serves)}}
What is the HTTP Age header the tell of?¶{{c1::A cache served you — seconds the copy sat on the edge shelf; the origin never woke}}
What are the session cookie's three protective flags?¶{{c1::HttpOnly (scripts can't read it)}} · {{c1::Secure (HTTPS only)}} · {{c1::SameSite (other sites can't ride it)}}
Why re-check auth AFTER the proxy gate?¶{{c1::Forged requests skip gates — the check beside the data is the one they can't skip}}
What is a CDN?¶{{c1::Cache servers near users answering for the origin — vending machines stocked from one warehouse}}
What is your site's serving chain?¶{{c1::Cloudflare (DNS + edge cache) in front of Vercel (the Next.js origin)}}
Which one header revealed your site's backend?¶{{c1::CSP connect-src *.supabase.co — plus its live websocket wss://}}
What does X-Frame-Options: DENY defend against?¶{{c1::Clickjacking — nobody may iframe the site (CSP frame-ancestors 'none' is the modern twin)}}
What do curl's -I, -L and -v flags do?¶{{c1::Headers only (HEAD)}} · {{c1::follow redirects}} · {{c1::narrate the whole conversation}}
The docs said vercel.app but the wire said the custom domain — what is the lesson?¶{{c1::Trust the wire over the docs — docs drift, evidence doesn't}}
